course_source: Module 2 minsearch vector retrieval and cohorts/2026/04-evaluation/homework.md Q6/Using this framework, pinned bc7b6aad6b92a5611d3d37bf7521a363f3b9d398.
purpose: Verify that the actual Retriever reconstructs the eligible saved-rank cutoff candidates, not merely a diagnostic calculation. Measure setup/search and serialized application-context size separately; character counts are not model tokens or context-fit proof.
controls: Unchanged source/corpus, frozen development questions/references, encoder model/revision/device/normalization/text, filters, generation settings and active config. Separate retriever initialization per candidate; model-cache access is local-only. Each candidate gets its stated cutoff; hybrid gets title0 and RRF1 exactly as the replay, with candidate depth20.
acceptance: All 84 returned ID lists and metrics match replay exactly. No missing/duplicate question rows. Verify encoder resolution/corpus/zero-truncation reports. Each known no-loss candidate remains only eligible for downstream model-capacity/answer comparison; a mismatch triggers investigation, never rewriting expected data. No promotion or claim of full core readiness.
failure_policy: Retain partial rows and failure type, terminal status and actual query attempts. No retries or concurrent duplicate run after timeout. Do not run missing-model downloads.
context_fit: Unproven; do not convert characters to assumed model tokens.
heldout_exposure: 42 development questions only; final bank previously readable/validated but no final inference/selection.
next_action: Predeclare an eight-call ordinary application pilot on DIR-01, PAR-01, COM-01 and ABS-01: both verified cutoff-ten retrieval policies, same existing Phi3 model, evidence_first prompt and output budget. Reuse matching baseline receipts, verify request/config identities and retain primary plus whole-answer review. No promotion from retrieval alone.
outcome: All 84 fresh offline queries match saved IDs, reference coverage and metrics exactly. Both encoder reports match the pinned revision and corpus with zero truncated inputs. Vector@10 fully covers 20/35, hybrid-title0-RRF1@10 covers 25/35, both versus active vector@5 at 18/35. Hybrid@10 loses LIM-07 partial coverage versus vector@10. No generation or actual model-token context-fit proof.
